title: Extension Visits Granted on Visit Referrals — Unit Ledger Calculation
content:
An extension of an In-Group Specialist Referral, an HMO Specialist Referral, an Out-of-Network Referral or a Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) adds the type's extension units.

## Calculation

- The **extension visits** are the type's extension units, the per-type figure of the Referrals & Prior Authorizations schedule; one unit is one visit.
- The extension visits are a whole number of visits and are never fewer than one.
- The extension visits are the number posted to the referral's unit ledger as the extension grant.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Extension units of the type (hypothetical) | 4 |
| Extension visits | 4 |
| Units remaining before the grant | 0 |
| Units remaining after the grant | 4 |

A referral with 1 visit remaining that receives the same 4 extension visits has 5 visits remaining after the grant.
